parameters.query: SELECT policy_name, policy_text, category, priority FROM public.company_email_policies WHERE active = true ORDER BY priority ASC LIMIT 20

=SELECT lesson, situation_type, human_feedback FROM public.ai_email_feedback_lessons WHERE from_email = '{{ $('Summarize Thread').item.json.from_email }}' OR domain = '{{ $('Summarize Thread').item.json.domain }}' OR quickbooks_customer_id = '{{ $('Summarize Thread').item.json.quickbooks_customer_id }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

=INSERT INTO public.ai_email_drafts (
  message_id, thread_id, draft_id, quickbooks_customer_id,
  from_email, customer_name, company_name,
  original_subject, original_body,
  ai_case_summary, ai_risk_level, ai_suggested_reply,
  ai_suggested_subject, reasoning_for_human, human_review_notes,
  status, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.message_id }}',
  '{{ $json.thread_id }}',
  '{{ $json.draft_id }}',
  '{{ $json.quickbooks_customer_id }}',
  '{{ $json.from_email }}',
  {{ $json.customer_name ? "'" + $json.customer_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.company_name  ? "'" + $json.company_name.replace(/'/g, "''")  + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.subject       ? "'" + $json.subject.replace(/'/g, "''")       + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.body          ? "'" + $json.body.replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0,8000) + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.case_summary  ? "'" + $json.case_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.risk_level }}',
  {{ $json.suggested_reply_body ? "'" + $json.suggested_reply_body.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.suggested_reply_subject ? "'" + $json.suggested_reply_subject.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.reasoning_for_human ? "'" + $json.reasoning_for_human.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.human_review_notes || []) }}'::jsonb,
  'pending_review',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET
  draft_id   = EXCLUDED.draft_id,
  status     = EXCLUDED.status,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, draft_id, status

=INSERT INTO public.email_processing_log (message_id, event_type, event_data, error_msg)
VALUES ('{{ $json.message_id || "unknown" }}', 'processing_error', '{}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.error?.message || "Unknown error" }}')
